purpose: Keep the plant evidence system usable from Google Gemini Gems without making Gem, Opal, n8n or one vector database canonical.
cost_policy: Free Tier and no-cost Google account features are allowed. No paid SaaS plan or billing-enabled Google Cloud resource may be required.

classic_gem.update_mode: replace or update the same Drive file so the Gem reads the newest Drive version
classic_gem.limitations: Treat Classic Gem as a knowledge-file client. Direct arbitrary n8n webhook invocation is not assumed.

gems_from_google_labs.integration: schemas/chat-api.openapi.json and the portable retrieval JSON contract when external HTTPS steps are confirmed in the user's account
gems_from_google_labs.network_boundary: Opal cannot be assumed to reach 127.0.0.1. Do not expose the endpoint publicly without a separately approved authentication and HTTPS gateway.

response.evidence: array of source_id, volume, pdf_page, chunk_id, quote_or_summary, score channels
response.display_names: array with Taiwan authority and fallback status
response.generation_instruction: Only answer from approved Köhler evidence; default to zh-TW, support English, retain Taiwan display names, and refuse non-Köhler drugs.

secret_policy: Gemini API keys stay server-side in an ignored env file; never place them in a Gem instruction or Drive evidence pack.
